# AI Chat Exporter

> Export or print your ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini conversations as Markdown, PDF, HTML, Word, plain text or JSON.

A Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension that reads the open conversation, keeps its structure (code blocks, tables, math, citations, artifacts) and writes a clean file. Everything runs locally in your browser; there is no backend.
